queue.what: A tree that nothing imports is not covered by the build, whatever the build says. This is the general form of the compile defect found this round, and it is not only P11's: any piece shipping a destination subtree behind an unapplied mount is in the same position, P13 under P10 next. A green npm run build is not evidence about an unimported tree.
